g.text: Note: The code service has a median input of 1,469 tokens but a median output of 13 tokens - the signature of inline completion rather than

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: chat. Conversation medians are 1,020 input and 129 output. This asymmetry, not a difference in volume, is what drives the gap in

g.text: output share between the two services.
